newsitem.title: USA: Option Care buys three franchises.
newsitem.headline: Option Care buys three franchises.

text.p: Option Care Inc said Wednesday it acquired the assets of three former franchises, Birkel-Lockhart Inc of Lincoln, Neb., Pharmacy Associates Inc of Grand Island, Neb., and High Desert Infusion Services Inc of Victorville, Calif.
In conjunction with the Victorville acquisition, the company also acquired the assets of High Desert Outpatient Management Services, a Medicare-certified home health agency.
"Collectively, we expect that these businesses will add over $3.5 million in annual revenues to Option Care Inc," Rick Hanson, president, said in a statement.
The company reported 1996 revenues of $70.5 million.
"As we have said before, Option Care's strategy is to develop statewide one-stop home health capabilities in selected markets," Hanson said.
Option Care provides home health care services through a national network of 184 company-owned and franchised locations.
